sloka: हृतहृत्सा हनुमता पपात विधुराम्भसि ।तां हतां वानरेणाशु पतितां वीक्ष्य सिंहिकाम् ॥५-१-१९६॥
transliteration: hṛtahṛtsā hanumatā papāta vidhurāmbhasi ।tāṁ hatāṁ vānareṇāśu patitāṁ vīkṣya siṁhikām ॥5-1-196॥

translations.english: Heart torn asunder and killed by Hanuman, miserable Simhika instantly fell into the sea water. Observing it, the beings who ranged the sky said to the foremost of vanaras:
